title: Non-amenable C$^*$-superrigid groups that are not W$^*$-superrigid
summary: Using techniques at the intersection of deformation/rigidity theory, geometric group theory, and the theory of $C^*$-algebras, we construct a continuum of nonamenable groups $G$ that can be completely reconstructed from their reduced $C^*$-algebras $C_r^*(G)$, but not from their group von Neumann algebras $\mathrm{L}(G)$. These groups arise as infinite direct sums of amalgamated free product groups and constitute the first known examples of nonamenable groups exhibiting this phenomenon.
